page.overview:
Who is Bruno Hauptleiter?

Bruno Hauptleiter is the Ostlander mercenary captain who leads the Star of Victory a Tilean mercenary band.

Bruno is the third born son of a family of tinsmiths from Wolfenburg but rather than join the family business he ran away and joined a Tilean mercenary regiment serving in Hochland. A formidable figure, he quickly proved himself, rising in the ranks, first as sergeant and finally the captain of the company when his predecessor died in battle.

He and his men served with distinction in both Kislev and the eastern Empire, commanding high fees and establishing a reputation for discipline on and off the battlefield. A stern disciplinarian, Hauptleiter insisted his troops show the utmost restraint when sacking a fallen town.

In 2522 IC, during the Storm of Chaos, his company was hired by Elector Count Valmir von Raukov to help defend Wolfenburg, the city having already been sacked once by the army of Surtha Lenk. Manning the walls when the forces of Chaos attacked, Hauptleiter became separated from his men as the city fell, knocked out when a wall collapsed under him.
